strategic_architecture: Solo-commander Gruul (R/G) 'big dinosaur' turbo archetype - distinct from typical combo-piece turbo decks. Etali's ETB free-casts a card off the top of each player's library; the deck leans on fast mana and copy effects to chain Etali triggers into a critical mass of free spells, or transforms into Etali, Primal Sickness for a single lethal poison-counter swing. Sources: EDHREC 'Building Etali, Primal Conqueror for cEDH', mtgtop8.com archetype page.
